meta.name: baoyu-markdown-to-html
meta.description: Converts Markdown to styled HTML with WeChat-compatible themes. Supports code highlighting, math, Mermaid (rendered to PNG via headless Chrome), PlantUML, footnotes, alerts, infographics, and optional bottom citations for external links. Use when user asks for "markdown to html", "convert md to html", "md 转 html", "微信外链转底部引用", or needs styled HTML output from markdown.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 Markdown 转为带微信主题的 HTML
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要把 Markdown 文档转为适合微信发布的 HTML
copy.tagline_en: Convert Markdown to styled HTML with WeChat themes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to convert Markdown to HTML for WeChat publication

howto.what: 装上后，它会把 Markdown 文件转成带样式的 HTML，支持代码高亮、数学、Mermaid 图 (PNG)、脚注、提示块等；HTML 生成在原文件旁，重名时自动备份。可应要求把普通外链改为文末引用。
howto.when: 当你说出“markdown to html”“md 转 html”“微信外链转底部引用”等，或提出要把 Markdown 变成带样式的 HTML 时触发。

say.text: 把这篇 article.md 转成微信文章样式的 HTML。
把这份 Markdown 转成 HTML，普通外链改成文末引用。
say.note: 开启 --cite，mp.weixin 链接保留原位。

say.text: 把这份 md 转成 HTML，改用 grace 主题。

howto.what_en: Converts Markdown to styled HTML (inline CSS). Supports code highlighting, math, Mermaid rendered to PNG, footnotes, alerts. Saves file next to source; backs up existing HTML. Optionally moves ordinary external links to bottom citations.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for “markdown to html”, “md 转 html”, “微信外链转底部引用”, or request styled HTML output from Markdown.

say_en.text: Turn this article.md into styled HTML for WeChat.
Convert this Markdown to HTML and put ordinary external links in bottom citations.
Render this Markdown to HTML using the grace theme.
